/root/bot/venv/bin/python - <<'PYCODE'
import base64
F="/root/bot/bot/plugins/ai_chat.py"
s=open(F,encoding="utf-8").read()
A1=base64.b64decode("").decode("utf-8")
A2=base64.b64decode("").decode("utf-8")
A3=base64.b64decode("").decode("utf-8")

# 1) 提示词铁律:插在"立场铁律末行"之后、"对方把话说错"段之前
anchor1='    自己前后打架比答错更糟——宁可含糊，也别自相矛盾。\n    "\n## 对方把话说错时的规矩（务必遵守）\n"'
assert s.count(anchor1)==1, "锚点1 count="+str(s.count(anchor1))
head1='    自己前后打架比答错更糟——宁可含糊，也别自相矛盾。\n'
s=s.replace(anchor1, head1 + A1 + '    "\n## 对方把话说错时的规矩（务必遵守）\n"', 1)

# 2) 判定函数:插在yesman函数尾之后
anchor2='    return topic == "舍馆" and not any(w in a for w in quote_words)\n\n\n# 已知的"常见误传"'
assert s.count(anchor2)==1, "锚点2 count="+str(s.count(anchor2))
s=s.replace(anchor2, '    return topic == "舍馆" and not any(w in a for w in quote_words)\n\n\n' + A2 + '# 已知的"常见误传"', 1)

# 3) 主流程重答:插在 yesman 块 if answer is None 之后、硬性截断之前
anchor3='        if answer is None:\n            answer = _orig_answer\n\n    # 硬性截断：最多三句（模型不听话时兜底）。'
assert s.count(anchor3)==1, "锚点3 count="+str(s.count(anchor3))
s=s.replace(anchor3, '        if answer is None:\n            answer = _orig_answer\n\n' + A3 + '    # 硬性截断：最多三句（模型不听话时兜底）。', 1)

open(F,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(s)
import ast
ast.parse(s)
print("三处替换完成+语法OK")
PYCODE
echo "--- 验收标记 ---"
echo "是非问句铁律:$(grep -F -c '问去不去/是不是要正面答' $F) _YESNO_Q_RE:$(grep -F -c '_YESNO_Q_RE' $F) [是非问句]日志:$(grep -F -c '[是非问句]' $F)"
echo "md5: $(md5sum $F | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo "=====完====="
